programme.title: The World of Hammer
programme.desc: Dracula and the Undead. 1994. Narrated by Oliver Reed. A look at how Hammer defined Dracula as a seductive icon of forbidden desire and everlasting evil with clips from a number of classic films.

programme.title: Attack of the Giant Leeches
programme.desc: 1959. Horror. Directed by Bernard L. Kowalski. Stars Ken Clark, Yvette Vickers & Jan Shepard. A man discovers giant leeches are behind several recent disappearances, but will anyone believe him?

programme.title: Budgie
programme.desc: Dreaming of Thee. Stars: Adam Faith, Iain Cuthbertson & Lynn Dalby. Budgie's 3 weeks from release from prison with time off for good behaviour. However, Charles Endell visits him on visiting day.

programme.title: Hi, Mom!
programme.desc: 1970. Comedy. Director: Brian De Palma. Stars Robert De Niro & Allen Garfield. A Vietnam veteran returns to New York and begins filmmaking, but he soon falls in with a group of radical activists.

programme.title: Europe in 25 Questions
programme.desc: A rare treat, courtesy of a Dutch airline, about air travel in the 1960s.

programme.title: Target: The Corruptors
programme.desc: To Wear a Badge. 1961. Stars Stephen McNally, Robert Harland & Harold J. Stone. Investigative reporters Paul Marino & Jack Flood investigate various cases of industrial corruption. (S1, E10)

programme.title: The David Niven Show
programme.desc: Good Deed. Stars Keefe Brasselle, Jay C. Flippen & James Best. British actor David Niven, introduces this 1950s US anthology series. (S1, E12)

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Granny Versus the Weather Bureau. 1964. Stars Irene Ryan, John McGiver & Quinn O'Hara. Granny's old-fashioned ways of predicting the weather are pitted against the Weather Bureau's technology.

programme.title: Look At Life One for the Road
programme.desc: 1965. A thought provoking look at the problem of drinking and driving and how it is being tackled.

programme.title: Confessions of Boston Blackie
programme.desc: 1942. Mystery. Director: Edward Dmytryk. Stars Chester Morris, Harriet Hilliard & Richard Lane. A reformed thief becomes involved in a case to find a woman's missing sculpture of Augustus Caesar.

programme.title: Calling Paul Temple
programme.desc: 1948. Crime Drama starring John Bentley & Dinah Sheridan. Scotland Yard is unable to unravel the 'Rex' murders and cannot manage without the help of Paul Temple and his sidekick 'Steve'.

programme.title: Look At Life Where Have All...
programme.desc: ... the Butterflies Gone? 1968. An enchanting look into the natural world of the butterfly and the reasons for the apparent shortage of them.

programme.title: Innocent Meeting
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Director: Godfrey Grayson. Stars Sean Lynch, Beth Rogan & Raymond Huntley. A teenager is falsely accused of robbery. A young girl must persuade him to give himself up.

programme.title: The Cure For Love
programme.desc: 1949. Comedy. Directed by & stars Robert Donat. Features Reneé Asherson & Thord Hird. A sergeant returns from the war and tries to reconcile with his fiancée but winds up falling for a new lodger.

programme.title: Murder on Campus
programme.desc: 1961. Crime Drama. Directed by Michael Winner. Stars Terence Longden, Donald Gray and Diane Clare. A reporter learns that his brother, a student at Cambridge, has killed himself or so it seems.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Blackbeard. 1956. Stars Alec Clunes, George Margo & Peter Hammond. Blackbeard becomes suspicious when a new governor arrives in the Bahamas and offers the pirates pardons from the King.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: The Knock on the door. 1976. Stars Jean Anderson, Patrick O'Connell & Richard Easton. Brian rejects Jane's budget, Barbara questions Brian on his divorce and Gwen gets a visit from the police.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Illegal Entry. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Walter Gotell & Adrienne Corri. Maguire gains insight into a recent wave of robberies after a man is arrested for skulking around on the roof of a shop.

programme.title: Seance On A Wet Afternoon
programme.desc: 1964. Thriller. Director: Bryan Forbes. Stars Richard Attenborough, Nanette Newman & Kim Stanley. A medium stages a kidnapping which she will then 'solve' by pretending to be psychic.

programme.title: A Travelogue of Kent in 1954
programme.desc: A short travelogue describing the history of Kent in 1954, with a look at the towns that made up the Cinque Ports.

programme.title: Those British Faces
programme.desc: 1993. Documentary series that acts as a tribute to the greats of British cinema. Narrated by Richard Todd, looking at the life of James Justice Robertson.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Pannage/Dry Fly Fishing on the River Test. 1981. Jack Hargreaves watches woodland pigs foraging for acorns at pannage time. He then continues his album of dry fly fishing on the River Test.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1957. The White Cliffs Mystery. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Starring Russell Napier, Yvonne Andre and Peter Bathurst. A dead rocket engineer was being blackmailed. But why - and by whom? (S1, E25)

programme.title: Buccaneer
programme.desc: A Kind of Cuckoo. 1980. Stars Bryan Marshall, Shirley Anne Field & Clifford Rose. Monica digs into Burton's past and the new board clashes over control, cash and contracts.

programme.title: Train of Events
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Directed by Sidney Cole, Charles Crichton and Basil Dearden. Starring Jack Warner, Susan Shaw and Gladys Henson. A train disaster is told as four short stories.

programme.title: An Affair in Mind
programme.desc: 1988. Crime Drama. Directed by Colin Luke. Stars Amanda Donohoe, Stephen Dillane & Hilary Mason. A young novelist falls for a married woman, who then wants him to kill her husband.

programme.title: Look At Life Men Against the Sea
programme.desc: 1965. For centuries the Dutch have fought against the sea. This film takes a look at the Delta Plan - a spectacular sea-defence scheme in Holland, and what it aims to achieve.

programme.title: Budgie
programme.desc: And the Lord Taketh Away. Stars: Adam Faith, Iain Cuthbertson & Lynn Dalby. Budgie is out of prison and living with his wife Jean in Watford. But soon he is back in his old Soho hunting ground.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Sign of Four
programme.desc: 1987. Thriller. Director: Peter Hammond. Stars Jeremy Brett, Edward Hardwicke, Jenny Seagrove. A young lady contacts Sherlock Holmes for his help regarding her father who disappeared 10 years ago.

programme.title: Frail Women
programme.desc: 1932. Drama directed by Maurice Elvey and starring Mary Newcomb and Owen Nares. The story of Lillian who has an illegitimate war baby adopted by a wealthy spinster. Filmed at Twickenham Studios.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Cunningham Heritage. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, H. Marion Crawford & Archie Duncan. Sherlock and Watson investigate a murder, with a young lady as the prime suspect.

programme.title: Black Saddle
programme.desc: 1959. The Freight Line. Western with Peter Breck. After his brothers are killed in a shootout, a gunfighter decides to hang up his guns and uphold the law by becoming a lawyer.

programme.title: Death of an Angel
programme.desc: 1952. Crime Drama. Directed by Charles Saunders. Stars Patrick Barr, Jane Baxter & Raymond Young. When a village doctor's wife is unexpectedly murdered, the new physician sets out to find answers.

programme.title: Talk About Jacqueline
programme.desc: 1942. Comedy. Director: Harold French & Paul L. Stein. Stars Hugh Williams & Carla Lehmann. A woman meets a researcher. When they marry, he runs across some scandalous gossip about her past.

programme.title: The Pale Faced Girl
programme.desc: Directed by Francis Searle. With Fidelma Murphy, Kevin McHugh, Tony Rohr, Patrick Duggan. It's Saturday night in Dublin, and Mick is attempting to chat up Cecilia.

programme.title: Black Beauty
programme.desc: 1971. Drama. Director: James Hill. Stars Mark Lester, Walter Slezak & Peter Lee Lawrence. The story of a horse who is separated from a young boy and his life with different owners over the years.

programme.title: The Tornados 'Robot'
